en.sayed-ali-raza: they said by way of pride and vanity. “Now you order half of it to come to you and the other half of it remain (in its place).”
The Holy Prophet ordered the tree to do the same. Then half of the tree advanced towards him in an amazing manner and with greater humming. It was about to touch the Prophet of Allāh.
Then they said, disbelieving and revolting, “Ask this half to get back to its other half and be as it was.”
The Prophet ordered it and it returned.
